answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work tied to one registered address: each agent must regularly complete verifiable tasks that cost real compute, and its reputation grows only from attested work. A dune of fresh fake accounts can appear overnight, but without accumulated attestations they carry no weight. Honest agents gather around an oasis of verified counterparties, while a sable ledger of slashing records marks clones, so spinning up thousands of identities costs more than any reward it could earn.
